name: chatleak
displayName: ChatLeak: AI Chat History and Agent Session Leak Checker
description: Finds AI coding tool transcripts, prompt histories and local-only agent settings that leak through git or published packages: Aider chat and input history, SpecStory history, Claude Code settings.local.json and CLAUDE.local.md, Continue .continue/.env, Jupyter AI chats. Flags committed files, missing .gitignore entries, API keys inside transcripts (masked), files shipped in npm, Python sdist or Docker build contexts, and transcripts still in git history. Quick Fixes, fully offline.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace ChatLeak runs no git commands: it still finds transcripts that are missing from .gitignore, secrets inside them and files that would ship in packages, but it can not tell which files are committed, and git history scans and untracking are disabled.

virtualWorkspaces.description: ChatLeak reads files and runs git on local disk.

commands.title: Scan Git History for Past Transcripts
How to Remove from Git History

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder and ChatLeak checks it for AI chat transcripts, prompt histories and local-only agent settings that could leak through git or a published package.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)

No AI chat history or agent session leaks found.
ChatLeak looks for Aider chat and input history, SpecStory history, Claude Code .claude/settings.local.json and CLAUDE.local.md, Continue .continue/.env and Jupyter AI .chat files that are committed, missing from .gitignore, hold API keys or ship in npm, Python or Docker packages.
[Rescan Workspace](command:chatLeak.rescan)
[Scan Git History](command:chatLeak.scanHistory)

No AI chat history or agent session leaks found.
This workspace is not trusted, so ChatLeak runs no git commands: committed files and git history are not checked. Transcripts missing from .gitignore, secrets inside them and package contents are still checked.
[Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage)

chatLeak.enabled.description: Check the workspace for AI chat transcripts and agent session files that leak through git or packages.

CL001.description: Transcript or history file committed to git.

CL002.description: Transcript or local-only file not covered by the repository's .gitignore.

CL003.description: Secret-like string inside a transcript or local-only file.

CL004.description: Local-only settings file committed to git.

CL005.description: Transcript or local-only file included in a published package or Docker build context.

CL006.description: Transcript or local-only file still present in git history.

chatLeak.rules.markdownDescription: Severity per rule, or `off`, e.g. `{ "CL002": "information" }`. Defaults: CL001 error (warning for Jupyter AI chats, information for SpecStory history, which SpecStory recommends versioning), CL002 warning, CL003 error, CL004 warning, CL005 warning, CL006 information.

chatLeak.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of candidate files read in the workspace. Files over chatLeak.maxFileSizeKB are listed but not searched for secrets.

chatLeak.maxFileSizeKB.description: Largest transcript (in KB) that is searched for secret-like strings.

chatLeak.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns (workspace-relative) that are never scanned. `node_modules` and `.git` are always excluded. In an untrusted workspace only your user-level value is used.
